summary.text: John Fetterman is a U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania, elected in November 2022 and sworn in on January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: He served as mayor of Braddock for 13 years and was elected Pennsylvania's Lieutenant Governor in 2018.
Fetterman grew up in York, attended Albright College, and lives in Braddock with his family.
